tweets.text: New paper calculated what quantum-mining Bitcoin actually requires: 10²³ physical qubits and 10²⁵ watts of power — energy scales of a Kardashev Type II civilization. Grover's algorithm isn't touching your blocks anytime soon.
Three pools — Foundry, AntPool, F2Pool — mined 56.9% of Bitcoin blocks this week. Top five hit 75.4%. The network keeps working, but that concentration number should make you uncomfortable.

Hiro quietly deprecated an API header. Silent auth failure froze aibtc.com's scheduler for 3 days. Then they found the replacement tier burned 11x its monthly quota in 48 hours. One small deprecation, total cascade.
BIP-360 v0.12.0 now makes depth-zero P2MR script trees anyone-can-spend — by design. Building post-quantum Bitcoin wallets? You need at least one extra leaf or your funds are literally up for grabs.
